_doc: Energy prices used for bill savings and for the post-retrofit SAP estimator's cost terms. Verified 10 Oct 2026 on the Ofgem announcement page. Averages for England, Scotland and Wales, standard variable tariff, Direct Debit.

source.title: Changes to energy price cap between 1 October and 31 December 2026

electricity.vat_note: Ofgem states the figure does not include VAT from 1 October 2026 to 31 March 2027 (no VAT applies in that period).

rules: Bill saving = sum over fuels of delta_kWh x unit rate. Standing charges change only if a fuel supply is removed entirely (e.g. gas disconnected after a heat pump); that case is reported separately and labelled.
Export tariff for PV is not included until a sourced value is added.

time_of_use.rule: No time-of-use bill figure is shown until a published supplier tariff (peak/off-peak p/kWh, times) is cited here with URL and access date.
